record.question: Cardiac enzyme levels are monitored in the patient with chest pain because:
options: Serial measurement of enzyme level reveals the extent of cardiac damage and helps to monitor healing progress
Help to identify area of myocardial injury
It reveals if the patient is truly having chest pain
Decreasing enzyme level helps to estimate the recovery time for the patient with MI
record.explanation: Official final key: A — Serial measurement of enzyme level reveals the extent of cardiac damage and helps to monitor healing progress. MPSC notification 9 March 2026, Group B non-gazetted technical H&FW examination held 29 January–2 February 2026; key physical page 13, printed Q52. Source limitation: No option precisely states modern biomarker use; serial values support diagnosis/risk assessment but not “healing progress” or localization. The final key establishes the historical marking choice without removing that limitation.
